biography.plain_text: Philip Erdoes was an American venture capitalist who founded Bear Ventures and built businesses in logistics, manufacturing and technology. A biology graduate who later trained in law and business, he moved from legal practice into entrepreneurship. Based in New York, he also co-founded Bear Cognition, developing analytics tools for commercial users.

long_biography.plain_text:
Philip Erdoes entered furniture manufacturing after struggling to find nursery furniture he liked for his children. With partners, he launched ducduc and secured a substantial retail order before production was ready. Initial manufacturing by Amish makers gave way to a Connecticut factory, where domestic production allowed quicker responses to customer changes.

He and his brother, Peter, also established a scholarship fund for Oklahoma State University's Oklahoma City campus. The programme supported students selected for leadership, citizenship, service and communication, with tuition waivers covering up to fifteen credit hours across a school year. It reflected their own experience growing up with limited means.
